howto.what: Claude 会帮你设计一个产品指标仪表盘，包括北极星指标、输入指标、健康指标和业务指标，并为每个指标定义数据来源、可视化类型、目标和告警阈值。
howto.when: 当你要求创建指标仪表盘、定义KPI、设置产品分析或构建数据监控计划时触发。

say.text: 帮我为我们的SaaS产品设计一个指标仪表盘。
say.note: Claude会输出完整的仪表盘规格。

say.text: 定义三个输入指标来驱动北极星指标“月活跃用户”。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you design a product metrics dashboard including North Star, input, health, and business metrics, with data sources, visualizations, targets, and alert thresholds for each.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a metrics dashboard, define KPIs, set up product analytics, or build a data monitoring plan.

say_en.text: Design a metrics dashboard for our SaaS product.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a full dashboard spec.

say_en.text: Define three input metrics to drive the North Star metric 'Monthly Active Users'.
